title: ‘Saturday Night Live U.K.’: Here’s Where to Watch Season 2 Online for Free
summary: This weekend, SNL U.K. has Danny Dyer as host and Sasha Keable as musical guest.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

“Live from London, it’s Saturday Night!” Saturday Night Live U.K. season one was a big hit in the United Kingdom and United States, alike, when it first aired in late 2025. And now, for this weekend, the sketch comedy show features with actor Danny Dyer to host, while singer-songwriter Sasha Keable is booked to perform as musical guest .

Although SNL U.K. season two broadcasts live on Saturday (Oct. 10) at 10 p.m. BST on British broadcaster Sky UK, it drops in the U.S. on the following day on Sunday (Oct. 11) at 9 p.m. ET/6 p.m. PT on Peacock .

Meanwhile, Danny Dyer stars in the hit period drama/comedy Rivals and the second half of season two returns in November. It’s streamable on Disney+ and Hulu . As for Sasha Keable, the singer-songwriter is set to perform during the second week of the Austin City Limits Music Festival in Austin, Texas after her appearance on SNL U.K.
